doc.title: Epic Breakdown - Story 2.6
doc.snippet: Real-time updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) or polling via API. Progress calculation: (processed_count / total_count) × 100. Time estimation: average processing time per entity × remaining entities. API endpoint: GET /api/gomafia-sync/status (returns current progress). UI component: Progress bar (ShadCN/UI Progress) with custom labels.

doc.title: Architecture Documentation
doc.snippet: TanStack Query 5.0.0 for server state with polling configuration. ShadCN/UI components for progress display. WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility requirements. Testing standards: 80% coverage minimum, TDD approach, Vitest for unit/integration, Playwright for E2E.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Progress indicators should provide visual feedback for long-running operations. Use ShadCN/UI Progress component with smooth animations. Color-coded status indicators (blue = in progress, green = complete, red = error). Real-time updates with smooth transitions.

doc.title: Previous Story - Import Error Handling
doc.snippet: ErrorSummaryTracker integration for error counts. TanStack Query polling pattern established with useImportErrorSummary hook (2 second interval). ShadCN/UI component patterns established (Progress, Card, Badge). ImportOrchestrator patterns for phase execution and error handling.

Existing SSE endpoint for progress streaming. Can be used as reference pattern for new SSE endpoint at src/app/api/gomafia-sync/import/progress/stream/route.ts.
ShadCN/UI Progress component for progress bar display. Use this component for progress visualization with smooth animations.

Database models for storing progress state. SyncStatus table stores current sync status with progress, currentOperation fields. ImportProgress model exists but may need enhancement for detailed phase and entity tracking.

packages.package: Next.js framework for API routes and SSE

constraint.rule: Clean Architecture pattern: Business logic in `src/lib/gomafia/import/`, API routes in `src/app/api/`, components in `src/components/import/`
Use TanStack Query for server state (progress polling). Configuration in `src/lib/queryClient.ts`. Polling interval: 2 seconds when import running, or SSE for real-time updates (< 1 second latency)
Use ShadCN/UI components: Progress for progress bar, Card for container, Badge for status indicators, Spinner for loading state. All components must be accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance)
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text
80% test coverage minimum, TDD approach. Unit tests for progress calculations, integration tests for progress tracking flow, E2E tests for progress display, accessibility tests using axe-core
Progress updates must be atomic and consistent. Database updates should be efficient (batch updates where possible). Real-time updates via SSE preferred over polling for lower latency
Store progress state in database (SyncStatus or ImportProgress table) to persist across page refreshes. Load progress state on page load if import is running

interface.name: GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/progress
interface.signature: GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/progress - Returns current import progress with phase, percentage, entity counts, time estimates

interface.name: GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/progress/stream
interface.signature: GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/progress/stream - Streams progress updates every 1 second via SSE

interface.name: useImportProgress hook
interface.signature: useImportProgress(): { data: ImportProgress | null, isLoading: boolean, error: Error | null } - TanStack Query hook for fetching and polling import progress

interface.name: ImportProgressCard component
interface.signature: ImportProgressCard({ progress, onRefresh, onStart, onStop, className }): JSX.Element - Displays progress bar, phase, metrics, and status

interface.name: Progress calculation utilities
interface.signature: calculateProcessingRate(processedCount: number, elapsedSeconds: number): number - Calculates entities per second. calculateEstimatedTimeRemaining(remainingCount: number, processingRate: number): number - Calculates seconds remaining. calculateProgressPercentage(processedCount: number, totalCount: number): number - Calculates 0-100 percentage

interface.name: SyncStatus model
interface.signature: SyncStatus { id: string, progress: number, currentOperation: string, isRunning: boolean, ... } - Stores current sync status and progress

interface.name: ImportProgress model
interface.signature: ImportProgress { id: string, operation: string, progress: number, totalRecords: number, processedRecords: number, ... } - Stores detailed import progress

tests.standards: Testing standards require 80% coverage minimum with TDD approach. Use Vitest for unit and integration tests, Playwright for E2E tests. Write tests before implementation following Red-Green-Refactor cycle. Test progress calculation utilities for accuracy and edge cases. Test progress tracking flow during import (integration). Test progress display in UI (E2E). Use @axe-core/playwright for accessibility testing to verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

locations.location: tests/unit/ - Unit tests for progress calculation utilities
tests/integration/ - Integration tests for progress tracking flow
tests/e2e/ - E2E tests for progress display

idea.description: Unit test: progress-calculator.test.ts - Test calculateProcessingRate with various inputs, test calculateEstimatedTimeRemaining with edge cases (zero rate, zero remaining), test calculateProgressPercentage with boundary values (0%, 100%)
Integration test: import-progress-tracking.test.ts - Test ImportOrchestrator updates progress during import, verify progress persists to database, test phase transitions update progress correctly

Integration test: progress-api.test.ts - Test GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/progress returns correct progress data, test SSE endpoint streams updates every 1 second, test SSE closes on import completion
Component test: ImportProgressCard.test.tsx - Test component displays progress correctly, test progress bar updates smoothly, test status colors are correct, test handles missing data gracefully

E2E test: import-progress-display.spec.ts - Test user views import status page, progress displays correctly, progress updates in real-time, phase transitions are shown, progress persists across page refresh

E2E accessibility test: import-progress-accessibility.spec.ts - Use @axe-core/playwright to verify WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, test keyboard navigation, test screen reader compatibility, test color contrast ratios
